response.sql: WITH obs_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as tel_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT tel_count, CAST(tel_count AS REAL) / SUM(tel_count) OVER () as share FROM obs_counts), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), above_average AS (SELECT tel_count, share, share - a.avg_share as excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN overall_avg a WHERE share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(tel_count) as combined_telescopes, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(excess) as average_excess FROM above_average;
